option_relations.rationale: Coccidioidomycosis is not mentioned in the context of the patient's current condition.
CNS toxoplasmosis is directly mentioned and supported by positive serum and CSF toxoplasma markers and typical imaging.
Primary CNS lymphoma was considered but excluded after biopsy, making it unrelated to the current diagnosis.
Bacterial brain abscess was empirically treated but deemed unlikely after negative cultures and definitive parasitic diagnosis.
Tuberculoma was in the CNS differential but excluded by negative acid-fast bacillus (AFB) tests.
Fungal abscess was ruled out on brain biopsy, making it unrelated to the current diagnosis.
Bacterial pneumonia was initially treated but seems less relevant given the lack of clinical response and other findings.
Pulmonary tuberculosis was considered but unlikely after negative sputum AFB smears.
